mapper.sql:
FROM ( SELECT * FROM ics31_compliance_write INNER JOIN ics30_compliance ON ( ics30_compliance_id = ics31_compliance_id AND ics30_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(ics30_start_date) FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_company_id = ics31_company_id AND ics30_start_date <= #{stdDate} AND COALESCE(ics30_date_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' ) AND #{stdDate}::date <= COALESCE(ics30_use_close_date, '2999-12-31'::date) ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= #{stdDate} ) ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON ( org02_code_id = org01_code_id AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_code_id = org01_code_id AND org02_mod_date <= #{stdDate} ) ) WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} ) org ON org01_code_id = emp03_org_code_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_title_cd != '900' /*비상근 제외*/ AND COALESCE(emp03_non_stay_yn,'false') != 'true' AND ( ( emp03_trans_cd = '900' AND #{stdDate} <= emp03_trans_date ) OR /*퇴사일 전까지만*/ ( emp03_trans_cd != '900' ) ) AND emp03_trans_cd != '800' /*겸직 제외*/ ) emp ON emp01_person_id = ics31_person_id WHERE ics31_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics31_yyyymm = TO_CHAR(#{stdDate}::date,'YYYY.MM') AND ics31_cycle_type = #{cycleType} AND COALESCE(ics31_fix_yn,'false') = 'true'
AND COALESCE(ics31_confirm_yn, 'false') = 'false'
AND UPPER(CONCAT(ics30_content, org02_kor_nm, emp01_kor_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ) t
mapper.select:
SELECT ics31_compliance_write_id AS compliance_write_id, f_cdnm('IcsComplianceType', ics30_compliance_type, ics30_company_id, #{stdDate}) AS compliance_type_name, ics30_sub_num AS sub_num, ics30_content AS content, f_cdnm('AnswerCode', ics31_answer_cd, ics30_company_id, f_sysdate()) || CASE WHEN ics31_reason IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '(' || ics31_reason || ')' END AS reason, org02_kor_nm AS org_name, emp01_kor_nm AS person_name, COALESCE(ics31_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn, COALESCE(ics31_confirm_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn
ORDER BY ics30_compliance_type, COALESCE(org02_sort_order, org01_org_cd) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpTitleCode', emp03_title_cd) , f_code_seq(emp01_company_id, 'EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd) , emp01_emp_no , ics30_sub_num LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
